The carry-forward source is the S101 W4 working paper §Carry-Forward (items 21, 22), the S101 BF-spine workshop CF (item 23), the S101 W8 working paper §Carry-Forward + closeout §V.2/§VI (items 24, 25), and the closeout §VI referee-M5 register flag (item 26). ```yaml
# ---- Identity (6 fields) ----
gate_id: "W5-1-CF-S102-H0-ANCHOR-INDEPENDENT"
schema_version: "R3"
trigger: "[SIGN]"
classification: "PHONONIC"
agent_type: "volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist"   # substrate-derived energy-content (effacement/vacuum-tracking) is the Volovik-partition Level-2 leg; mack-cosmic-bridge writes the falsifier-watchlist H_0 row (writer_agent below). Volovik owns the substrate energy-leg derivation; mack owns the σ-distance + register surface.
hypothesis: "Joining the Volovik-partition Level-2 substrate energy-content leg to the W4-4 convergent-a2 Level-1 G_N-ratio leg yields an H_0 readout that does NOT degenerate to H_obs at N->1, producing a genuine substrate-derived prediction with a computable sigma-distance to SH0ES/Planck and NO anchor re-injection."

  description: "Construct the joint L1(+)L2 H_0 estimator. Level-1 (W4-4 convergent-a2): the G_N-ratio channel H_0^(L1) = H_obs * sqrt(G_N^FW/G_N^obs) with G_N^FW/G_N^obs = N (N=0.999859 from s101_w4_h0_proper_a2.npz). This leg ALONE degenerates: at N->1 the readout -> H_obs (anchor re-injection). Level-2 (Volovik partition, S58/S60): supply a substrate-derived energy-content leg rho_substrate(tau_fold) (effacement Gamma_eff=0.99970 + vacuum-tracking rho_vac/rho_obs) that fixes the Friedmann normalization WITHOUT borrowing H_obs. The joint estimator H_0^joint = f(N, rho_substrate) must (a) reduce to a value DISTINCT from H_obs at N=N_W4-4 AND at the N->1 limit, (b) carry a substrate-derived energy leg (no external Omega_m injection), (c) emit a sigma-distance to SH0ES (73.04 +/- 1.04) and Planck-LCDM (67.34 +/- 0.54). PASS iff non-degeneracy + substrate-energy-leg + sigma-distance all hold; INFO iff the L2 leg cannot be made anchor-free (degeneracy persists -> the 67.40 ratio-channel readout stands, anchor-independent H_0 remains future work)."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_h0_anchor_independent.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "set"          # multi-condition: non-degeneracy AND substrate-energy-leg AND sigma-distance-computable
  form: "(|H_0^joint(N->1) - H_obs| > delta_degen) AND (energy_leg_substrate_derived == True) AND (sigma_distance computable from substrate-derived covariance)"

  L_max: "10"                    # convergent-a2 G_N-ratio leg evaluated at canonical L_max=10 (W4-4 lineage)
  scan_range: "N/A"             # no scan; fixed-input evaluation + analytic N->1 limit
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: "1e-4"             # relative tolerance on the joint-estimator algebra (matches the N=0.999859 |N-1|=1.4e-4 W4-4 precision)
  scheme: "FW"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE-L1-L2-JOINT-substrate-energy-leg"   # joint Level-1 (G_N-ratio) (+) Level-2 (Volovik-partition energy) estimator; explicit that the energy leg is substrate-derived, NOT external-Omega-injected
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg"      # scalar/small-vector algebra; CPU
  publication_precision: "4"    # H_0^joint cited downstream in the falsifier-watchlist H_0 row at 4 sig figs (matches 67.40/65.4 precedent)

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The joint L1(+)L2 H_0 readout does NOT degenerate to H_obs at N->1."

    Step 1 (Level-1 G_N-ratio leg, W4-4 lineage):
        H_0^(L1)(N) = H_obs * sqrt(N),   N = G_N^FW/G_N^obs   [s101_w4_h0_proper_a2.npz: N=0.999859]
        Limit:  lim_{N->1} H_0^(L1)(N) = H_obs * sqrt(1) = H_obs.
        => Level-1 ALONE degenerates to H_obs at N->1 (the disclosed anchor degeneracy; falsifier-watchlist H_0 row).
    Step 2 (Level-2 Volovik-partition energy leg, S58/S60):
        rho_substrate(tau_fold) = rho_vac_tracking * Gamma_eff   [Gamma_effacement=0.99970; vacuum-tracking rho_vac/rho_obs from S60/S66]
        This leg fixes the Friedmann normalization H_0^2 = (8 pi G_N^FW / 3) * rho_substrate
        WITHOUT borrowing H_obs (rho_substrate is a substrate-IS quantity, not an external Omega_m * rho_crit(H_obs)).
    Step 3 (Joint estimator):
        H_0^joint(N, rho_substrate) = sqrt( (8 pi G_N^FW / 3) * rho_substrate )
                                    = sqrt( (8 pi / 3) * (G_N^obs * N) * rho_substrate )
        Substitute G_N^FW = G_N^obs * N:
        H_0^joint = sqrt(N) * sqrt( (8 pi G_N^obs / 3) * rho_substrate )
    Step 4 (N->1 limit of the JOINT estimator):
        lim_{N->1} H_0^joint = sqrt( (8 pi G_N^obs / 3) * rho_substrate )  =: H_0^* (substrate-fixed)
        This limit is H_0^* = f(rho_substrate, G_N^obs) -- it is NOT H_obs unless rho_substrate happens to equal
        Omega_m * rho_crit(H_obs). The substrate rho_substrate is fixed by tau_fold + Gamma_eff, INDEPENDENT of H_obs.
        => Non-degeneracy holds iff |H_0^* - H_obs| > delta_degen, i.e. iff rho_substrate is NOT tuned to reproduce H_obs.
    Step 5 (Direction read-off):
        The degeneracy in Level-1 came from H_obs APPEARING in H_0^(L1) = H_obs*sqrt(N). The Level-2 leg REPLACES
        H_obs with the substrate-derived sqrt((8 pi G_N^obs/3) rho_substrate). The substitution removes the H_obs
        prefactor entirely; what remains is anchor-free.
    Conclusion: H_0^joint carries a substrate-derived energy leg and its N->1 limit H_0^* != H_obs by construction
        (PASS iff |H_0^* - H_obs| > delta_degen AND rho_substrate is substrate-derived). If the L2 leg cannot be
        made anchor-free (rho_substrate inadvertently reintroduces H_obs), degeneracy persists -> INFO.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "The joint L1(+)L2 H_0 readout is anchor-independent: its N->1 limit H_0^* differs from H_obs by > delta_degen, the energy leg is substrate-derived (no external Omega_m injection), and a finite sigma-distance to SH0ES/Planck is computed. The 67.40 ratio-channel readout stands as the canonical (anchor-degenerate) H_0; an anchor-independent H_0 remains future work. Reallocates the dual-prior toward Track B. ```yaml

CAC: w_0(L) := rho_X(L) + offset_X with offset_X = w_0_FW - rho_X(L=10), X=Zubarev default, so w_0(L=10)=w_0_FW EXACTLY by construction (effacement-preservation criterion). BUT branch-iv targets w_0_B=-0.842454, NOT the canonical w_0_FW=-0.918 -- the branch-iv CAC anchors offset_B = w_0_B - rho_B(L=10). The gate computes rho_B(L) from a spectral-triple-direct evaluator, forms the branch-iv-anchored CAC, and tests (a) reproduction of w_0_B at L=10 within 1e-5 with ZERO free normalization, (b) CAC spread max_{L in {8,10,12}} w_0(L) - min ... <= 0.025. INFO iff still inadmissible (evaluator-less branch-iv CONFIRMED, sharpening the S101 derivation-inadmissible record)."
  producing_script: "computations/_shared/s102_branch_iv_canonical_eval.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "set"     # two conjoined conditions: reproduction at L=10 AND CAC spread bound
  form: "(|w_0(L=10) - w_0_B| <= 1e-5  with zero free normalization) AND (max_{L in {8,10,12}} w_0(L) - min_{L in {8,10,12}} w_0(L) <= 0.025)"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "reproduction tolerance 1e-5 on |w_0(L=10) - (-0.842454)|; CAC spread bound 0.025"
  direction: "<="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "regulator-convention-lockdown.md (CAC effacement-preservation criterion: w_0(L=10)=anchor EXACTLY by construction => reproduction at L=10 is analytic IF the evaluator exists); the open question is whether a ZERO-free-normalization spectral-triple-direct rho_B(L) EXISTS (S101 W4-3 found the surrogate route inadmissible)"

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous"     # w_0(L) is continuous in the spectral moments; the L-axis is the integer mesh {8,10,12}

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "3"                    # rho_B(L) evaluated at L in {8,10,12} for the CAC spread test
  L_max: "12"                    # max truncation for the CAC spread; canonical anchor at L=10
  scan_range: "[8, 12]"        # L-axis CAC spread window (the regulator axis for DR3-class L_max-stability)
  step_size: "2"                # L in {8, 10, 12}
  tolerance: "1e-5"             # reproduction tolerance on w_0_B at L=10
  scheme: "zeta"                # rho_X spectral-moment scheme; Zubarev/zeta default per CAC (regulator-convention-lockdown.md)
  convention: "CAC-branch-iv-anchored-L10-DERIVED-OFFSET"   # branch-iv-anchored canonical-anchored convention; offset_B = w_0_B - rho_B(L=10) per regulator-convention-lockdown.md (NOT the rho-direct convention RDC, which is OUTSIDE the admissibility class)
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.linalg"      # D_K block diagonalization at L=12 (largest block dim ~9792, dense 1.53 GB << 17 GB VRAM per math-scripts.md D_K block-diagonality note)
  regulator_pin: "a_4^{Mellin}"  # branch-iv R-slot consumes the a_4-channel Mellin-cone residue structure; Seeley-DeWitt a_4 regulator tag MANDATORY per regulator-pin-discipline.md
  publication_precision: "6"    # w_0_B = -0.842454 carried at 6 sig figs (matches the registered branch-iv value precision)

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The CAC spread over L in {8,10,12} must be <= 0.025 for branch-iv DR3-readiness."

    Step 1 (CAC definition, regulator-convention-lockdown.md):
        w_0^CAC(L) := rho_B(L) + offset_B,   offset_B := w_0_B - rho_B(L=10)
        [w_0_B = -0.842454; rho_B(L) = spectral-triple-direct branch-iv moment at truncation L]
    Step 2 (Substitute the anchor identity at L=10):
        w_0^CAC(L=10) = rho_B(L=10) + (w_0_B - rho_B(L=10)) = w_0_B   EXACTLY.
        => reproduction at L=10 within 1e-5 holds BY CONSTRUCTION IFF rho_B(L) is a well-defined
           zero-free-normalization evaluator (the S101-inadmissible question).
    Step 3 (CAC spread):
        spread = max_{L in {8,10,12}} w_0^CAC(L) - min_{L in {8,10,12}} w_0^CAC(L)
               = max_{L} [rho_B(L) + offset_B] - min_{L} [rho_B(L) + offset_B]
        The constant offset_B cancels in the difference:
               = max_{L in {8,10,12}} rho_B(L) - min_{L in {8,10,12}} rho_B(L)
    Step 4 (Direction read-off):
        spread is the bare truncation variation of rho_B(L) over {8,10,12}. PASS iff this variation <= 0.025.
        A small spread <=> rho_B(L) is L_max-converged at the canonical truncation <=> the branch-iv DE object
        is truncation-stable enough for the DR3 R_842 reversal protocol (~2027).
    Step 5 (Diagnostic vs the S101 record):
        S100b W1-4 found the diagnostic sensitivity span (0.000830, 0.036327) CROSSES the 0.025 boundary under
        UNPINNED recombination candidates -> the recombination freedom was DECISION-RELEVANT. THIS gate removes
        the recombination freedom by building rho_B(L) DIRECTLY from the spectral triple (zero free normalization);
        if such an evaluator exists, the spread is a determined number, not a convention choice.
    Conclusion: PASS iff a zero-free-normalization spectral-triple-direct rho_B(L) reproduces w_0_B at L=10
        within 1e-5 AND its bare truncation spread over {8,10,12} <= 0.025. INFO iff no admissible
        zero-free-normalization evaluator exists (branch-iv evaluator-less CONFIRMED, sharpening S101 W4-3).

        w_0 bounds:  R_842^inv = [-0.94, -0.88]  vs  R_842^atlas w_0-projection = [-0.942, -0.742]. DIFFERENT

        value -0.842, the inventory on the CANONICAL value -0.918).
        => The two are NOT the same rectangle; they track DIFFERENT branches.
    Step 4 (Reconciliation -- which is the binding DR3 falsifier rectangle):
        The atlas-09 item 37 2D rectangle [-0.942,-0.742]x[-0.2,0.2] is the BINDING DR3 falsifier rectangle:
